correctness.rationale: The precise Bayesian fractional rule yields log-odds increments +a below 0 and -b at or above 0 (a=log(1/g_-)>0,b=log(g_+)>0). The half-open interval [-b,a) is forward invariant; iterations outside add a or subtract b until capture. t=(u+b)/(a+b) yields rotation mod 1 by rho=a/(a+b). Every high branch is exactly an integer wrap, telescoping to H_n=floor(t0+n*rho), giving strict discrepancy <1 even when the threshold is attained. Rotation periodicity, density and Fourier uniqueness give the rational/irrational dichotomy and the normalized logistic density. Branchwise chain derivative equals x_n(1-x_n)/[x0(1-x0)] on smooth itineraries, bounded away from zero/infinity after capture. Prime-11 valuations show irrationality for g_-=22/125,g_+=93/50; prime-17 similarly for 3/17,13/7. Independent 18,000-step orbits checked capture and exact wrap counts; finite computation does not establish irrational density.
